title: CWP/16733/2025 of SONU Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH REKEK 131 CWP-16733-2025 Date of Decision: 29.07.2025 Sonu Petitioner Versus StateofHaryanaandothers Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HARSH BUNGER Present: Mr. Ravi Malik, Advocate for the petitioner. Ms. Upasana Dhawan, AAG, Haryana. 28K Ae RK HARSH BUNGER J. (ORAL) Prayer in the instant civil writ petition filed under Articles 226/227 of Constitution of India, inter alia, is for issuance of a writ in the nature of Mandamus for directing respondents to conduct enquiry on the complaint dated 04.02.2025 (Annexure P-1), submitted by the petitioner.

2. At this stage, learned State counsel, on instructions from Mr. Rajesh Sharma, District Development and Panchayat Officer, Panipat, submits that the complaint submitted by the petitioner is being enquired into by the learned Chief Executive Officer, Zila Parishad, Panipat (respondent No.5 herein) and that the enquiry proceedings would be concluded within a period of four months from today.

3. Keeping in view the aforesaid submissions made by learned State counsel, the present writ petition is disposed of accordingly. 4, All pending application (s), if any, shall also stand closed. 29.07.2025 (HARSH BUNGER) Pd JUDGE Priyanka 1.
